_comment: Reference snippet — merge this `hooks` block into ~/.claude/settings.json (do NOT replace the whole file). `hooks/install-hooks.sh` does this safely via jq. Adjust the path if you installed clawd somewhere other than the default sketchybar config dir. Each session is tracked by its session_id, so one dot per running session; SubagentStart/SubagentStop add the running-agent count badge (they carry the parent session_id, and older Claude Code versions that don't emit them simply never badge).
